cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Stay until sunset. Gran predicted this stone would hatch, and I promised we'd witness the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then help me record that it didn't hatch. We can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

mechanism: A treats its pupil as a trained witness, using accurate observation and question correction to keep B until an impossible prophecy has a definite outcome or deadline.
confusable: Not endless belief or generic control: A accepts failure if it can be recorded and requires a responsible revision when the date is missing.
comparison: Undated family prophecy versus a wrongly set clock.
seedUse: D146 Gran/stone/sunset/date/phone; S05 trained observation records.
